title: Roof PV
boundaryClipped: Touches the survey boundary; the outline may be incomplete.
undone: The latest action was undone; its audit history is retained.
transformed: Manual operation saved. The new polygons are pending review.
splitHint: Click a cutting line that crosses the selected polygon, then finish. New parts require confirmation.
zoomHint: Zoom to level 16 or closer to inspect PV outlines. At most 1,000 outlines are rendered per view.
subtitle: Image review workspace
mapHint: Select a polygon or a candidate. Wheel to zoom; drag to pan.
uncalibrated: Uncalibrated; not an accuracy or identity probability.
reviewerHint: Enter your name before saving a decision.
reasonHint: Required for rejected or uncertain decisions
drawingHint: Click at least 3 corners on the map, then finish. Checking an area records inspection, not absence of PV.
editingHint: Drag the vertex handles. Save explicitly to persist the changed shape.
exportHint: EPSG:3035 · Includes all candidates and a separate confirmed PV layer.
saveBeforeExport: Save or discard your pending edits before creating an export.
noRuns: No completed runs. Run the Python sample pipeline, then reload.
saved: Decision saved to the review database.
added: Polygon saved. Manually added PV still requires confirmation.
limitsText: PV image review and provisional MaStR comparison. Image presence, rooftop mounting and registry identity are reviewed separately. Scores are uncalibrated; storage is linked by registry location without exclusive allocation.
attribution: Imagery: GeoBasis-DE/LGB, dl-de/by-2-0. OSM: © OpenStreetMap contributors.
missingReason: Enter a reason for this decision.
select: Select a candidate to inspect its evidence.
refreshHint: If a version conflict is reported, reload to inspect the latest decision before retrying.
viewTruncated: This view exceeds the drawing limit. Zoom closer to inspect all outlines.
registryAcquiring: Waiting for the frozen MaStR import. Acquisition progress is shown above.
registryIdentityHint: Image presence and registry identity are separate decisions. Scores rank alternatives; they are not probabilities. No identity is accepted automatically.
staleGroups: groups changed since this proposal batch; rebuild before identity review.
registrySearch: Search MaStR ID, municipality or postcode
cohort_target: Active building PV up to 30 kWp, no coordinates
storageNoAllocation: Rows are relationships, not allocations. A storage system can be shared; do not sum capacity once per PV record.
selectRegistryUnit: Select a registry record to inspect its attributes and image alternatives.
competingIdentity: This registry unit already has an accepted or probable review on another group. Check whether this is a shared array or a conflicting assignment.
staleIdentity: The image members or registry snapshot changed. Rebuild proposals first.
confirmArrayGrouping: I checked that these regions form the array group being associated.
verifiedIdentityRequirement: Verified identity requires independent evidence, checked grouping and all member regions confirmed as rooftop PV. Rebuild proposals after image edits.
selectArrayForMatching: Select an image candidate or a proposed image alternative to review its registry identity.
discardIdentity: Discard the unsaved registry identity decision?
identityEvidenceRequired: Describe the identity evidence or reason before saving.
identitySaved: Registry identity decision saved separately from the PV image review.
matchingScheduled: Proposal generation was scheduled. Progress appears above; the batch refreshes when complete.
evidence_registry_coordinate_review: Public registry coordinates and roof verification
flag_image_group_not_human_verified: Array grouping is a proposal and needs human inspection.
flag_contains_unreviewed_or_uncertain_pv: Some member regions lack confirmed PV-presence review.
flag_roof_mounting_unverified: Roof mounting is not confirmed for every member.
flag_large_group_check_for_multiple_inst: Large region group: check for multiple installations.
flag_module_count_power_review: Reported module count and power need a consistency check.
flag_context_record_outside_active_build: Context record; outside the active building-PV ranking scope.
flag_coordinate_outside_declared_municip: Public coordinates lie outside the declared municipality.
flag_contains_non_roof_review: Contains a ground/other mounting review; excluded from rooftop registry ranking.
flag_tied_best_alternatives: Several best alternatives have the same ranking score; their order does not establish identity.
flag_invalid_commission_date: The commissioning date is invalid and was excluded from temporal scoring.
flag_invalid_power: The registered gross power needs correction.
flag_municipality_name_ags_disagreement: Municipality name and official municipality code disagree; the code determines the normalized municipality.
rankingLimitations: Current ranking uses available spatial, area and temporal evidence. Panel facing azimuth and postcode geometry have not been compared automatically.
onlyFiveAlternatives: At most five examples are shown; ties do not identify a unique installation.
candidateExamplesHint: Numbered points are image alternatives, not known registry locations. At most five scored examples plus saved links are shown.
emptyRegistryList: No registry records match these filters.
clickCandidatePoint: Click a candidate point on the map
chooseCandidateOnMap: Your selected registration has image alternatives on the map. Click a numbered point to compare and save an association here.
chooseRegistryFirst: Select a MaStR registration on the left, then click one of its map points. You can also inspect any PV outline directly.
inspectImageMembers: Review PV presence and roof mounting
noLinkedRegistry: No saved links for this array yet.
registryScoreCaution: Compatibility scores are not identity probabilities. Keep ambiguity when evidence is insufficient.
candidatePointMeaning: Points mark detected arrays, not official small-unit coordinates.
registrationDeclaredStorage: Storage declared at the same location
registrationNoStorageRecords: No storage relationship was extracted in this snapshot.
